items.author: pandaax.bsky.social
items.context: I’ve been playing the cozy games like Palia or loftia but lately they don’t feel very cozy but very very grindy and it killed the mood for me lol
items.text: Totally fair, cozy stops feeling cozy once it turns into a to-do list. Games with no timers or daily goals, like A Short Hike or Unpacking, tend to feel much calmer.

items.author: sailor-youranus.bsky.social
items.context: Coral Island? It's great! It's like a more magical stardew valley set on a pacific island with hotter men to woo
items.text: Coral Island is a lovely pick. Restoring the reef gives it a different feel from Stardew, even with the farming.

items.author: gm-kitkatarine.bsky.social
items.context: i love games that are just. Task. Repetitive task. Bookkeeping. Diagnostics. Task task task. no time limit, nothing. just me and the repetition. I picked up Peggy's Post again on itch.io and if you too love Task Without Time Limits please play it. One of my favorite chill cozy games.
items.text: Calm repetitive tasks with no time limit are such a good way to wind down. Thanks for the rec, itch.io is full of quiet little games like that.
